summary: Output achieves 93.5% source file coverage (well above the 80% gate) and all 4 phases executed correctly. MCP data quality, INDEX assembly, and document design quality all pass. The critical gap is section completeness: 83/106 documented file blocks are missing 数据流 and/or 核心接口 sections — a direct violation of the MANDATORY Step 4 post-write validation that sub-agents were required to perform. This single failure (skipped validation) cascades into R5, P3, S3, S5, and S6 failures. Secondary issues: 6/7 DETAIL files lack YAML front matter and use task IDs instead of module IDs in HTML markers. Root cause is split between agent errors (ignoring explicit validation instructions) and Skill ambiguity (task_id vs module_id not distinguished; no main-agent quality gate blocking Phase 4 progression). Priority fix: strengthen phase3-detail.md to tie submit_analysis to a verified section count.
